sentences.text: VesselChain is a cohort company whose country is recorded as ES, and the sources we read hold no register entry for it.
The record is mostly appearances: seven exhibitor or demo entries between 2024-02-29 and 2026-09-16, plus an award record dated 2024-11-25 and a product launch dated 2025-05-26.
A grant or public funding record dated 2025-02-24 is at low confidence and should be checked at its source.
A programme-entry record on the apelago.fi site is dated 2026-02-09.
Every readiness level is unknown on the radar's rules.
For the fund this stays on the watchlist until a funding or customer record can be confirmed.
